findings.summary: Headline result uses default amounts, so the reader may take away a number that isn't theirs.
86,492 from 70,000 paid in looks too low for 7%; the inflation ('today's money') adjustment is only a small line, so the main figure is hard to understand.
Red minus shekel amounts next to funds in the list read like losses rather than gaps.
Hedged fund's range of +2,212 to -23,766 is scary and unclear.
Too many jargon tags on every fund.
Top pick is an unfamiliar non-bank house and fund manager.
